FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
Posted caps bow to conditions, so sixty-five can still break the rule on a rainy night two-lane [A01].
Why it matters: group rule-concept; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A01
Careful-prudent plus reasonable-proper spans traffic, pedestrians, road, sight, weather, and self [A01].
Why it matters: group conditions; difficulty low; prereq sec07-F01; confusables sec07-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A01
Crawling that blocks traffic breaks the rule from below, while rear-ending a stopped leader breaks it even under the cap [A01].
Why it matters: group too-slow-vs-clear-distance; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A01
The law trio bars uncareful speed, unreasonable speed either way, and speed beyond assured clear stopping [A01].
Why it matters: group law-trio; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A01
Speeding risks six hundred fifty-four dollars plus thirty days, with school and work zones doubling fines around crews [A01].
Why it matters: group penalty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A02
Unposted normal caps step seventy-five, eighty, sixty-five, fifty-five, thirty-five, and twenty-five by road class [A02].
Why it matters: group chart; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A02
Towns set their own shifting caps, so business, residential, and school signs rule the block [A02].
Why it matters: group municipal; difficulty low; prereq sec07-F06; confusables sec07-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A02
Dark hides hazards and shrinks sight, so slow down and never outdrive lamp range or brake ability [A02].
Why it matters: group night; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A02
Tinted lenses compound glare and slow night adjustment while cutting vision, so drive bare-eyed [A02].
Why it matters: group lenses; difficulty low; prereq sec07-F09; confusables sec07-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A02
Rage climbs from tailgating to weapon threats, and targeted drivers flee to peopled stations, call for help, and skip home [A02].
Why it matters: group rage; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0041]
